gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: A freshly constructed size-0 NullInputStream should report no bytes available.
ADDED i2: Bounds check (offset + length > bytes.length) is performed before the closed-stream check, so an IndexOutOfBoundsException is expected even on a closed stream.
ADDED i3: When length == 0 the method short-circuits and returns 0 without checking whether the stream is closed, so no exception should be thrown.
ADDED i4: A valid-bounds read with length > 0 on a closed stream must throw IOException.
